description: Given name of the injured worker (from 'First name, middle initial, last name').
Middle initial of the injured worker (from 'First name, middle initial, last name').
Family name of the injured worker (from 'First name, middle initial, last name').
Date when the injury or occupational disease occurred.
Injured worker's Social Security number.
Injured worker's birth date.

text: Mailing address; add apartment number or P.O. Box, if applicable
description: Mailing street address for the injured worker.
Mailing city of injured worker.
Mailing state of injured worker.
Mailing ZIP code of injured worker.
Select injured worker's sex.
Injured worker's email address.
Injured worker's home telephone number.
Injured worker's mobile phone number.
Name of the injured worker's employer.
Street address of the employer.
Employer city.
Employer state.
Employer ZIP code.

text: Was the injured worker hired through a temp agency?
description: Indicate if the injured worker was hired via a temporary staffing agency.

text: If yes, name of temp agency
description: Name of the temporary agency that hired the worker, if applicable.

text: Mark the days of the week you usually work
description: Select all days typically worked by the injured worker.
Start of regular work hours (include a.m./p.m.).
End of regular work hours (include a.m./p.m.).
Date the injured worker was hired.
Injured worker's job title at time of injury.
State where the injured worker was hired.
State where the injured worker was supervised when injured.
Hourly wage rate at time of injury.

text: Number of hours scheduled to work the week of this injury
description: Scheduled hours for the week when the injury occurred.

text: Work number for call-offs (Number injured worker calls to reach supervisor)
description: Phone number the injured worker uses to call supervisor for call-offs.

text: Part(s) of body affected (For example: Left knee, right index finger)
description: Describe body part(s) injured.

text: Accident description (Describe the sequence of events that directly caused the injury or death.)
description: Detailed description of sequence of events causing the injury or death.

text: Will the incident cause the injured worker to miss 8 or more days from work?
description: Indicate if the injury will result in missing eight or more days of work.
Start time of the injured worker's shift on the day of the incident.
Clock time when the injury occurred.
Date the employer was notified of the injury.

text: Was any part of a workday missed due to the injury?
description: Indicate if any work time was missed because of the injury.
If the injured worker has returned to work, provide the date they last worked due to this injury.

text: Was the place of the accident or exposure on employer's premises?
description: Indicate whether the accident location was on employer property.

text: If no, give accident location, street address
description: Street address of accident location when not on employer premises.

text: If no, give accident location, city
description: City of accident location when not on employer premises.

text: If no, give accident location, state
description: State of accident location when not on employer premises.

text: If no, give accident location, ZIP code
description: ZIP code of accident location when not on employer premises.
Indicate whether the injured worker was admitted to the hospital overnight.
Date of initial medical treatment for this injury.
Name of the facility where initial treatment was provided.
Name of the treating provider.
Phone number for the treating provider or facility.
Fax number for the treating provider or facility.
Street address of the treating facility.
City of the treating facility.
State of the treating facility.
ZIP code of the treating facility.
If applicable, date of death resulting from the injury.
Marital status of the decedent (if injury resulted in death).
Number of dependents of the decedent (if applicable).

text: Diagnosis(es)-narrative description including as appropriate, the location and body part, and ICD code(s).
description: Detailed diagnosis description from treating provider (list condition/disease and ICD code(s)).
Initial treatment date reported by treating provider (may duplicate earlier field).

text: Are the medical conditions you have listed above causally related to the reported work-related accident or occupational disease?
description: Treating provider indicates if listed conditions are causally related to the reported work event.

text: Are you the physician of record?
description: Treating provider indicates whether they are the physician of record.
Printed name of treating physician or provider.
Provider's BWC (Bureau of Workers' Compensation) provider number.
Date the treating provider signed/completed their section.
Employer name in employer's section (may duplicate earlier employer name).
County of the employer.
Employer phone number.
Employer fax number.
Employer email address.
Policy number associated with the employer's workers' compensation coverage.
Employer's federal identification number (EIN).

text: Injured worker is (Check box, if applicable.)
description: Check if injured worker is Owner/Sole proprietor, Partner, or Individual incorporated as a corporation.

text: Employer certifies the facts in the application.
description: Employer certifies the facts in the application.

labels: Certification – I certify the facts in this application are correct and valid.
Rejection – I reject the validity of this claim for the reason(s) listed below.

description: If rejecting the claim, list the reason(s) for rejection.

text: For self-insuring employers only: Medical only / Lost time
description: For self-insuring employers, indicate if claim is medical only or lost time.
